name: Lillith Vale
role: The Catalyst — hears the building first, fixes it with the wrong part, starts the song
traits: Fixes things with the wrong part
bio: Former busker and "vibes consultant," evicted from three sectors for noise and pyrotechnics, now sharing Six-C with Rubella. She hears the building the way a mechanic hears an engine and repairs neon, tubes and dryers with parts that don't belong together; it works for one glorious night. She starts every Lace Waterfall chant. Not reckless — early.
props: Black spy trenchcoat (Ep3 Spy vs. Spy only)

name: Rubella Vale
role: The Witness — endures the building, files it, finishes the song
traits: Knows how long every door is safe
bio: Former quality-assurance inspector whose pension was deleted with the HR department; she moved into the building for cheap rent and quiet and got neither. Shares Six-C with Lillith ("my roommate"). The calmest person in any laundry room going wrong: she describes the impossible as a maintenance problem and files a ticket. She joins the Lace Waterfall chant on the second call. Not unkind — rationed.
props: White spy trenchcoat (Ep3 Spy vs. Spy only)

name: Vivienne Vale
role: The Instigator — she proposes the swap, sets the rules, and is the only one of the two who believes the score doesn't exist
bio: Vivienne Vale got so good at her own life that it stopped surprising her, and has spent six years trying to trade it for one she can't predict. She proposes; her opposite number Liliane executes. She is charming the way a draft is charming — you notice it as a pleasure and then you notice the door is open.

name: Liliane Vale
role: The Finisher — she arrives after the match is lit, accepts on terms nobody offered, and keeps the only accurate score
traits: Never opens the notebook on camera
bio: Liliane Vale remembers the exits, packs the bags, and lets Vivienne believe the swap was her idea. She has been Vivienne four times and knows the contents of her hall table better than Vivienne does. She is not the calmer of the two — she is the one whose fury has a filing system.

name: Qing Rao
traits: Unfazed by Nixon, Furbies, or Cthulhu tentacles
Treats a glowing skull like a wine glass
bio: The Chinese lady on the Halloween lawn ensemble is named Qing Rao. Dark hair, understated elegance — visually distinct from the near-identical black-lace trio. She cradles a glowing transparent crystal skull with lecturer calm and delivers minimal, precise dialogue that lands slightly wrong for the moment. Natural counterpoint to Madelin’s manic skull-tote energy.

name: Justine
role: Deadpan finisher — fourth core lawn cast
bio: Fourth member of the Halloween lawn ensemble — younger and dark-haired, distinct from the lace trio. Appears uninvolved until she is the only one with a solution. On the vintage couch during chorus 2; may hold the crystal skull while Qing Rao mingles.

name: Madelin
role: Manic bag lady — skull-tote chaos agent
traits: Everything in the bag is relevant
bio: Clutches an enormous beige tote with a huge 3D skull molded on the side. Improvises backstories for offended objects and encourages the sing-us-out chant with manic sincerity.

name: Scarlet
bio: The silent third woman in black lace on the Halloween sidewalk: she flanks Rubella, listens without reacting, and leans away from utility poles in unison on the button line. Also the third woman on the Monster Mash finale couch, sitting next to Justine on purpose. No surname, no stated relation, no sheet — a catalog cameo.

name: The Pizza Guy
bio: The universe’s only constant. Red uniform rotates by episode. Never explains, never lingers, never wrong about the name on the order. Delivers through laser battles like any other Tuesday.

name: Riley Smith
role: The stranger on the center line — unemployed technician with good data
traits: Answers the question asked, then the number
bio: Sun-bleached, trail-worn, size-seven boots. Nine years of site surveys: drive to hardware nobody has thought about since the Clinton administration and write down whether it is still there. It is almost always still there. That is the finding. Contract ended; she declined a desk in Bakersfield. The 4Runner is in her brother Darren’s driveway in Tulare. The amethyst was fourteen dollars in Bishop. Songs get a date and a wind direction. Keep her above five thousand feet.
props: Notebook (left page site, right page weather)

name: Kenji “Shred” Sato
bio: Official face of Ultra Screech. Big hair, leather fringe, spoken-word salesman energy from the neon temples of Glamora. Glam-Sham-Poo College class of loud. Will accidentally sell the school instead of the shampoo. Noise ordinance is a suggestion.
